# MetroFuse 10.0 Beta 4

- Android routes the Discord sign-in callback directly to the authorization flow and accepts either supported slash form while still checking the OAuth state.
- MetroFuse waits for the Discord gateway greeting before identifying. A stalled token exchange or gateway sign-in now shows an error instead of leaving “Authorizing…” on screen indefinitely.

Install the signed Android APK over Beta 3. On Windows, extract the x64 ZIP and run the launcher.
